items.title: HP1800: The Magic of Single-Stage 48V to Ultra-Low Voltage
items.summary: HP1800 PWM phase-doubler turns 1 tri-state PWM input to four 180° interleaved complementary outputs. It enables 90–92% efficient single-stage 48V-to-1V AI PoL conversion (vs ~86% two-stage), cutting PCB area 75% and parts 40%. It supports legacy controllers, programmable dead-time, anti-shoot-through logic, 200kHz–2MHz switching to lower data-center power cost.
